title: ObjectAgentManifest
description: YAML front matter for a kind: object agent in /agents/user/<name>/SYSTEM.md or a bundled native agent. The Markdown body below the closing --- is the system prompt. User virtual-file writes enforce this schema and the runtime manifest parser.

name.description: Object agent name. Graph 'agent' nodes reference this string in agent_registry.

description.description: What this object agent does. Not exposed on the parent task tool (object agents are internal).

kind.description: Must be 'object' for agents under agents/objects/.

model.description: Optional model override, e.g. 'azure_ai:tools-default'. Defaults to the parent agent's model.

tools.description: Tool names resolved against the parent's tool registry (e.g. git_command, gh_command, current_time).

skills.description: Individual skills, each a /skills/<name> folder containing SKILL.md. Each is loaded into the agent's prompt and mounted read-only; do not repeat it under mounts. To expose all skills as files, mount /skills/ instead.

mounts.description: Explicit virtual filesystem paths available to the agent. Paths must be beneath an existing Progenitor route.

permissions.description: Extra filesystem permissions layered on top of default skill-isolation rules.

interrupt_on.description: Tool names requiring human approval before executing (HumanInTheLoopMiddleware).

memory.description: Give the agent private, writable memory: its /memories/ is its own folder (stored under /memories/agents/<name>/), and every file there is loaded into its prompt. Cannot be combined with a /memories/ mount.

git_write.description: Bundled agents with shell: true only. Lets the wrapped git/gh run repository setup commands (clone, fetch, pull --ff-only, switch, worktree add/remove, submodule, branch create, remote add/set-url, gh repo clone); push, commit and history-rewriting or work-discarding commands stay refused. The shell also gets PROGENITOR_REPOS_DIR, the managed repos directory.

git_publish.description: Bundled agents with git_write: true only. Also lets the wrapped git/gh push named branches other than main/master (never forced, no refspecs) and run gh pr create; GitHub authentication uses the passed-through GH_TOKEN via gh's credential helper. Commit stays refused.
